name: pitchboom.io
tagline: Paste a link, get a motion-design video ad. No avatars.
maker_comment_excerpt: Hi Product Hunt, I'm Arsène, a solo founder in Paris. pitchboom turns your product page into a motion-design video ad. Paste a URL, or two lines about what you sell: it writes the script and a storyboard you edit and approve for free. Only then does it record the voice-over, add music and render the MP4 in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5 or 3:4, recomposed for each feed, not cropped.
